title: The Fort Dearborn monument's figures are bodies now
items: On 18th Street in 1904, the five bronze figures of the Fort Dearborn Massacre monument are no longer joined from rods and balls: each is one of the walkthrough's own people, posed joint by joint to the two photographs of the sculpture and cast in the same bronze.
Still to do: their faces are the people's plain ones, not the sculpted faces, and the hair, drapery, inscription and weathered front panel are not yet modelled.
